item.title: Show HN: Multicoder ACP – Run Claude/Codex/OpenCode from the same VS Code GUI
item.summary: I am working on a VS Code extension which allows to run any (ACP-compatible) agent harness from the same GUI. Shows session outline - all tool calls, click for details. Shows all edits the agent did, allows to find quickly which session modified the current file. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49244211 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
